description: Sign-in, MFA, PAM, and identity governance for all 45,000 workforce users
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Every division system federates to SYS-G1; no sign-in means no STPP, no POS back office, and no RMM console
manual_workaround: Sealed break-glass accounts per critical system; offline intake forms at stores

business_process: Cloud landing zones and hub network
description: Network hub, guardrails, keys, and logging in providers A and B
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: The STPP, the customer engagement platform, and the retail website run behind the provider A hub
manual_workaround: Fail over the STPP to its provider B standby (read-only intake first)
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: STPP; SYS-G4; retail website and app; IT Support PSA integrations

description: Links from 1,120 repair stores, 260 retail stores, 5 depots, and the 2 colocation data centers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Stores cannot reach the STPP or the retail payment switch without connectivity
manual_workaround: Cellular failover at every store and depot; P2PE terminals can process on cellular
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All repair stores, in-store counters, retail stores, and depots

description: 24x7 SOC, SIEM, EDR, and incident handling for all divisions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Notice clocks (24-hour acquirer and manufacturer terms, Form 8-K Item 1.05, 164.410) keep running during an outage; blind spots let attackers move between divisions
manual_workaround: Retainer firm's tooling; EDR console access from provider B
dependent_third_parties: SIEM and EDR vendors; forensic retainer
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: All divisions depend on the SOC for detection and breach facts

description: Card, cash, and gift card checkout on POS lanes at 260 stores through the payment switch
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $34.5 million revenue per day across the division; PCI DSS controls must stay in place in degraded mode
manual_workaround: Offline lane mode with the processor's store-and-forward limits; cash only if the switch is down
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Repair tickets from in-store counters are paid at these lanes

business_process: Repair intake, ticketing, and device release
description: Intake with consent and passcode capture, ticket tracking, parts, and release of devices to the right customer on the STPP
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $10.7 million revenue per day; about 30,000 tickets a day; devices in custody must be released only to the owner
manual_workaround: Paper intake forms with numbered claim tags; read-only ticket lookup from the provider B standby
dependent_third_parties: Cloud provider A; SMS and email provider
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Used by the 260 in-store counters (Retail) and by IT Support in-home technicians

description: Card payments on P2PE terminals at repair stores and depots, deposits on the online booking page, and phone payments for mail-in repairs
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Devices are not released before payment; P2PE terminal scope must not change in degraded mode
manual_workaround: P2PE terminals process on cellular; hold devices for payment; no paper card numbers (POL-04)
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Separate repair merchant account; in-store counter tickets are paid on retail lanes (BP-ER01)

description: Online orders, checkout through the processor's hosted payment fields, order status, and store pickup
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 14% of retail revenue online; payment page scripts must stay under PCI DSS 6.4.3 and 11.6.1 control
manual_workaround: Phone orders through the contact center; store pickup only
dependent_systems: SYS-D3 web and app back end; SYS-G4 customer accounts
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Customer sign-in is SYS-G4, shared with repair booking and IT Support

description: Monitoring, patching, and remote management of about 310,000 endpoints for 4,200 business customers through the RMM
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customer contracts (service levels; HIPAA business associate agreements with 610 practices); customers' own security depends on patching and monitoring
manual_workaround: Technicians work from the PSA queue with direct remote sessions; urgent patches by customer-side tools
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: SYS-G1 sign-in; SYS-G2 monitoring of the RMM console

description: Diagnostics, flashing, repair, and data transfer on about 6,900 bench workstations with about 40 vendor tools
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Repairs promised same day for most consumer tickets; bench images rebuild from the gold image (RPO reflects image updates, not customer data)
manual_workaround: Manual diagnostics with manufacturer tools only; defer data transfers
dependent_systems: SYS-D2 bench workstations and tools; SYS-D1
dependent_third_parties: Manufacturer A and B diagnostic tools; tool vendors
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: In-store counters connect to retail store networks (SYS-D4)

business_process: Managed backup and recovery for customers
description: Nightly backup of customer servers and cloud tenants to the managed backup service, and restores on request
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers' own recovery depends on it (including practices' ePHI); missed backups widen customers' data loss
manual_workaround: Backups resume from the last good copy; customers' local snapshots

description: Repair and replacement for device protection plan claims through the TPA interface (about 38% of repair volume)
process_owner: Device Repair vice president of partner programs
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: TPA service levels and claim volumes; plans are sold by Electronics Retail
manual_workaround: Claims captured on paper and keyed when the interface returns; TPA phone authorization

business_process: Customer accounts, contact center, and chatbot
description: One customer account across divisions, CRM, contact center, and the group customer chatbot
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customer sign-in for repair booking, retail orders, and subscriptions; repair status calls
manual_workaround: Guest checkout and booking; contact center works from the STPP and order system directly

description: Remote sessions and in-home visits for about 1.3 million subscribers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Subscription service levels; in-home visits are scheduled days ahead
manual_workaround: Reschedule visits; phone support
dependent_systems: SYS-D5 remote support tool and PSA; SYS-D1 for device tickets
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Subscriptions sold by Electronics Retail; device tickets in the STPP

description: Notices to managed services customers under contracts and business associate agreements
process_owner: IT Support security and compliance lead
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: 45 CFR 164.410 and business associate agreement clocks; managed services contract notice terms
manual_workaround: Out-of-band contact list (printed and on managed mobile devices)

description: Distribution, home delivery and installation scheduling, and store pickup
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Delivery promises; perishable demand around launches and holidays
manual_workaround: Manual pick lists; delivery partner portals
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Installations by IT Support in-home technicians

description: Sale of protection plans (as TPA agent) and IT Support subscriptions at checkout and online
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Plan enrollment must reach the TPA within its service window
manual_workaround: Queue enrollments and send in batch

description: Mail-in repair for consumers and depot repair for about 2,300 business accounts at 5 depots
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Enterprise service levels (most 5 business days); courier pickups
manual_workaround: Hold inbound shipments at the courier hub; paper receiving logs

description: Warranty claims, parts ordering, and serial traceability through Manufacturer A and B portals
process_owner: Device Repair vice president of partner programs
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Warranty reimbursement and parts traceability required by the program agreements
manual_workaround: Manufacturer phone support; paper parts logs

description: Close, consolidation, and SEC filings including Form 8-K
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Filing deadlines; a Form 8-K Item 1.05 filing is due 4 business days after a materiality determination
manual_workaround: Manual consolidation from division ledgers

description: Recovery from failed devices at 2 labs (about 38,000 cases a year) and data transfer at stores
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Customers wait days for recovery; the lab works from device images, so loss of lab storage means re-imaging
manual_workaround: Pause new cases; keep devices in the evidence cage
dependent_third_parties: Recovered-data delivery storage in provider A

description: Sanitization, verification, and certificates for about 1.1 million trade-in devices and 640,000 recycling drop-offs a year
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Devices must not leave for resale or recycling without verified sanitization (Fla. Stat. 501.171(8) worked example)
manual_workaround: Quarantine devices in locked cages until stations return

description: Trade-in quotes, customer identity capture, and store credit for used devices
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Trade-in volume can wait; devices are held for Device Repair pickup
manual_workaround: Paper trade-in forms
shared_services_and_cross_division_depen: Devices go to Device Repair depots (BP-DR08)

description: Time capture, payroll, onboarding, background checks, and terminations
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Biweekly payroll; terminations drive access removal; background check reports are consumer report information (16 CFR 682)
manual_workaround: Repeat prior payroll

description: Model-suggested diagnoses, repair estimates, and liquid damage flags on the bench
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Technicians can diagnose without it; outputs affect warranty decisions, so quality matters more than uptime
manual_workaround: Turn the feature off; technicians use manufacturer diagnostics

description: Loyalty accounts, points, and personalized offers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Points can be applied later
manual_workaround: Honor offers manually
dependent_systems: SYS-D3 loyalty; SYS-G4 customer data platform

description: AI agent that proposes and runs remediation scripts on managed endpoints for 40 pilot customers
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Pilot only; technicians do the same work by hand
manual_workaround: Turn the agent off
